Get Started OR Sign Up with Google View Plans Talk to Sales Frequently asked questions Is Apollo free? Yes. Apollo has a 100% free plan that you can sign up for above. If you would like some more advanced functionality, you can always start a free trial of any of our advanced plans, or transition onto one of our low-cost month to month plans and upgrade as you see fit. Our purpose is to help as many people solve their sales needs without trying to squeeze every dollar out of them! Does Apollo integrate with my existing workflow? Apollo integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, SalesLoft, Marketo, Sendgrid, LinkedIn, and all email providers to ensure that your workflow is upleveled wherever you live. We also offer API Access on our Custom plans for more advanced integrations. Is my business too small for Apollo? For a very low price, Apollo provides you with unlimited email addresses for every contact that could potentially buy your product. From there, we provide you with a sequencing platform that allows you to A/B test your emails, record your calls, automate your follow-ups, and create a repeatable process of setting up sales conversations. After setting up sales conversations, you can use our Opportunities feature to actually manage your sales pipeline and continue to use our database to pull information for more stakeholders within accounts and our emailing tools to automate your follow-ups and find out when your potential buyers are opening your emails. After closing your first deal with Apollo, you're left with a framework to repeatedly close business and scale your customer acquisition efforts. Does Apollo work with large enterprises? Of course! Apollo works with a number of Fortune 500 companies and large enterprises such as Ernst & Young, Oracle, and Lyft. Due to the complex needs of many large enterprises, we suggest talking to sales about our Custom plans to ensure that you have all of the integrations, security, and governance that you need. What is a sequence? Sequences are a feature designed to help you create a repeatable, semi-automated or fully-automated process to set meetings via automated or manual emails, phone calls, social touches, or generic tasks. They outline a repeatable number of steps that can be tested to measure which content resonates best with your audience. All of your contacts, accounts, and activities sync directly back and forth with your CRM via direct integrations or API. Sequences eliminate hassle for users in all customer-facing roles: Sales/Business Development, Sales, Recruiting, Customer Success, Account Management, Marketing, and more. Apollo will send and log your emails for you, schedule call and provide you with recordings & transcriptions, and help you maximize your success rates by analyzing your results and providing you with recommendations. How can I ensure that my emails won't go to spam? Apollo does everything that we can do from the technical perspective to help make sure that your emails get delivered. Along with that, we've built a best practices guide for users to follow to maximize their chances of not having prospects mark their emails as spam. Another suggestion would be to use our hyper-targeted filters in our database to create smaller, more personalized batches of emails.
